name: West Virginia

agency.name: West Virginia Offices of the Insurance Commissioner (OIC), Workers' Compensation

ttd.rateText: 66 and two-thirds percent of the average weekly wage earnings, wherever earned, at the date of injury, not to exceed 100% of the average weekly wage in West Virginia (W. Va. Code § 23-4-6(b)). Awards are not adjusted annually after they are made.
ttd.minText: Minimum is 33 1/3% of the state average weekly wage but may not exceed the benefit computed from the federal minimum hourly wage (§ 23-4-6(b)): OIC computes $7.25 x 8 hours x 5 days / 7 x 66 2/3% = $27.62 a day, i.e. $193.33 a week (spreadsheet value 193.33333...).
ttd.periodLabel: West Virginia fiscal year 2027: dates of injury / last exposure July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027 (SAWW $1,150.91)

waiting.text: No award if disability does not last longer than three days from the day the employee leaves work; if it lasts longer than seven days, the first three days are paid (W. Va. Code § 23-4-5).

ttdDuration.text: The aggregate TTD award for a single injury may not exceed 104 weeks for awards made since the 2003 amendment (W. Va. Code § 23-4-6(c)).

ppd.text: Permanent partial disability is paid at four weeks of compensation for each percent of disability, at 66 2/3% of the AWW, not to exceed 70% of the state average weekly wage (W. Va. Code § 23-4-6(e)(1)): FY2027 PPD weekly maximum as stored in the OIC spreadsheet: 805.637 (70% of $1,150.91).

facts.text: A worker's benefit rate is fixed for the entire span of all benefits, whether at the maximum, the minimum or an odd rate; TTD, PTD and fatal awards made on or after July 1, 2003 receive no annual escalation (OIC; § 23-4-6(b)).

The minimum weekly benefit is tied to the federal minimum wage ($193.33 a week) rather than to 33 1/3% of the state average weekly wage (383.6328303 in the OIC FY2027 spreadsheet), because the statute caps the minimum at the federal-minimum-wage level.

A permanent disability of 85% or more creates a rebuttable presumption of permanent total disability if the claimant is also at least 50% medically impaired on a whole-body basis or has a 35% statutory disability (§ 23-4-6(d)).
Permanent total disability benefits are payable until the claimant reaches the age for Social Security old-age retirement benefits (§ 23-4-6(d)).

uncertain: OIC 'Benefit Rates FY2027' is an .xlsx file (LinkClick fileticket Sn8WgOE_vBg); values are stored unrounded (min 193.333..., PPD max 805.637). min recorded as 193.33 per OIC's own computation note ($27.62/day).
Sections 23-4-5 and 23-4-6 list a 2026 amendment (HB5515); the text read on code.wvlegislature.gov on 2026-10-08 is assumed current.
